games.name: Void Incremental [v0.1]
games.desc:
You're trapped in a void, where darkness is so powerful, that nothing takes form as anything solid would under the light. Your only goal... Rebuild the glory that once was.

- Don't trust vobert. Remember to never trust a WORD he utters.
